nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender and updated in transferOwnership/claimOwnership/renounceOwnership.
BaseWallet._owner: wallet owner slot, only writable through initOwner (factory) or setOwner (module).
BaseWallet.modules: mapping of authorized modules, gate for onlyFromModule and onlyFromFactoryOrModule.
BaseWallet.controller: Controller instance used to resolve walletFactory and stores; controls onlyFromFactory checks.
BaseWallet.methodToModule: selector to module dispatch table used by fallback.
ReentrancyGuard._guardValue: reentrancy lock storage slot toggled by nonReentrant.
HashStore.hashes: wallet => hash => consumed map preventing signed request replay.
QuotaStore.quotas: per wallet rolling daily quota accounting (currentQuota, pendingQuota, spentAmount, spentTimestamp).
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap: wallet => addr => effective timestamp for whitelisting.
GuardianStore.wallets: per-wallet guardian arrays, indices, inheritor, lock and lastActive state.
Proxy storage slots: keccak-based implementation slot and proxy owner slot written/read via assembly sload/sstore.
PLACEHOLDER
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner ownership transfer, rejects zero address.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, sets owner to address(0).
Claimable.claimOwnership(): onlyPendingOwner, promotes pendingOwner to owner.
BaseWallet.initOwner(address _initialOwner): onlyFromFactory initial owner assignment guarded by _owner == 0.
BaseWallet.init(Controller, address[]): one-shot controller and initial module setup.
BaseWallet.setOwner(address): onlyFromModule owner change with zero/self/same checks.
BaseWallet.addModule(address): onlyFromFactoryOrModule, delegates to _addModule.
BaseWallet.removeModule(address): onlyFromModule, calls deactivate in try/catch then deletes module.
BaseWallet.bindMethod(bytes4,address): onlyFromModule, writes methodToModule dispatch entry.
BaseWallet.transact(uint8,address,uint,bytes): onlyFromFactoryOrModule, performs arbitrary call/delegatecall/staticcall via _call.
Payable fallback functions: BaseWallet.fallback (dispatches msg.data to bound module) and Proxy.fallback (delegatecall to implementation).
BaseWallet._call(uint8,address,uint,bytes): low-level call/delegatecall/staticcall dispatcher selected by mode.
BaseWallet._addModule(address,ModuleRegistry): validates module registry, stores module and calls activate() on it.
BaseModule.activate(): binds module methods into the calling wallet (re-enters the wallet).
BaseModule.deactivate(): unbinds module methods from the calling wallet.
UpgraderModule.activate(): reconfigures controller, removes/adds modules, migrates security store and removes itself.
GuardianStore.addGuardian(address,address,uint,bool): onlyWalletModule, timestamp-gated guardian addition.
GuardianStore.removeGuardian(address,address,uint,bool): onlyWalletModule, timestamp-gated guardian removal.
GuardianStore._cleanRemovedGuardians(address,bool): compacts guardian array and index mapping.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate(address,bytes32): requireWalletModule guarded replay protection write.
QuotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent(address,address,uint,PriceOracle): computes quota usage via oracle and adds to spent.
QuotaStore.addToSpent(address,uint): onlyWalletModule, increases spent amount.
QuotaStore.changeQuota(address,uint,uint): onlyWalletModule, schedules new quota with effective time.
WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist(address,address,uint): onlyWalletModule, sets whitelist effective time.
WhitelistStore.removeFromWhitelist(address,address): onlyWalletModule, removes whitelist entry.
OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeTo(address): onlyProxyOwner proxy implementation upgrade.
OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes): onlyProxyOwner upgrade plus arbitrary call{value} to itself.
UpgradeabilityProxy._upgradeTo(address): checks and stores new implementation.
UpgradeabilityProxy.setImplementation(address): assembly sstore of implementation slot.
OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy.setUpgradeabilityOwner(address): assembly sstore of proxy owner slot.
OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy.transferProxyOwnership(address): onlyProxyOwner proxy ownership transfer.
AddressUtil.sendETH(address,uint,uint): low-level value call with customizable gas, unsafe for reentrancy.
AddressUtil.fastCall(address,uint,uint,bytes): inline assembly call with arbitrary target/value.
AddressUtil.fastCallAndVerify: wraps fastCall and reverts with raw returndata.
SignatureUtil.verifySignatures(bytes32,address[],bytes[]): ordered signer verification loop.
SignatureUtil.verifyEOASignature: strips signature type byte and recovers ECDSA signer.
SignatureUtil.verifyERC1271Signature: staticcall into untrusted contract to check isValidSignature.
SignatureUtil.recoverECDSASigner: ecrecover with malleability bound on s and v checks.
BaseENSManager.register(address,address,string,bytes): onlyManager, verifies manager approval and registers forward/reverse ENS.
BaseENSManager.verifyApproval: requires recovered signer to be a manager.
SecurityStore.touchLastActive(address): onlyWalletModule, writes uint64(block.timestamp) to lastActive.
SecurityStore.setLock(address,bool): onlyWalletModule wallet lock flag.
SecurityStore.setInheritor(address,address,uint32): onlyWalletModule inheritance configuration with timestamp write.
BaseModule.reimburseGasFee: computes gasCost = gasAmount * gasPrice, charges quota, transfers fee.
ReentrancyGuard.nonReentrant modifier: reads/writes _guardValue around function body.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for ownership, module and authorization checks.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for guardian validity, quotas, whitelist and inheritance.
tx.origin: untrusted origin address, flagged as a phishing/authorization input class for this analysis.
Low-level call with value to an arbitrary address (BaseWallet._call, BaseWallet.transact failure path, upgradeToAndCall, AddressUtil.fastCall).
delegatecall into an arbitrary target executing untrusted code in the wallet/proxy storage context.
staticcall into an untrusted address (BaseWallet._call mode 3, SignatureUtil ERC1271 verification).
BaseWallet.fallback forwards msg.value and msg.data to a bound module without a reentrancy guard.
Proxy.fallback delegatecall to implementation resolved from storage (upgradeable proxy attack surface).
AddressUtil.sendETH value transfer performed before/without state finalization, external call reentrancy surface.
Inline assembly sstore writing implementation and proxy owner slots outside Solidity's type checks.
Guardian status/timestamp writes whose activation depends on comparison with block.timestamp.
Arithmetic gasCost = gasAmount.mul(gasPrice) in reimburseGasFee, overflow-checked by MathUint.
Assembly returndatacopy/revert bubbling raw returndata out of BaseWallet.transact.
newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter of Claimable.transferOwnership stored into pendingOwner.
_initialOwner parameter of BaseWallet.initOwner.
_controller parameter of BaseWallet.init.
_modules array parameter of BaseWallet.init.
_module parameter of BaseWallet.addModule.
mode parameter of BaseWallet.transact selecting call/delegatecall/staticcall.
to parameter of BaseWallet.transact (call target).
value parameter of BaseWallet.transact (ETH sent with the call).
data parameter of BaseWallet.transact (calldata forwarded to target).
wallet parameter of GuardianStore.addGuardian.
addr parameter of GuardianStore.addGuardian (guardian address).
validSince parameter of GuardianStore.addGuardian compared against block.timestamp.
alwaysOverride flag of GuardianStore.addGuardian controlling branch taking.
validUntil parameter of GuardianStore.removeGuardian compared against block.timestamp.
newQuota parameter of QuotaStore.changeQuota.
effectiveTime parameter of QuotaStore.changeQuota stored as pendingUntil.
pos local in addGuardian indexing into guardianIdx.
g (Data.Guardian memory) local used for status branching in addGuardian/removeGuardian.
success bool returned by _call inside BaseWallet.transact.
module local resolved from methodToModule[msg.sig] in BaseWallet.fallback.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, granting full authorization.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership to msg.sender == owner.
setOwner is gated by onlyFromModule which checks modules[msg.sender].
addModule is gated by onlyFromFactoryOrModule checking modules[msg.sender] or factory.
bindMethod is gated by onlyFromModule which checks modules[msg.sender].
addGuardian uses onlyWalletModule -> requireWalletModule(wallet) checking Wallet(wallet).hasModule(msg.sender).
verifyAndUpdate calls requireWalletModule(wallet) which validates msg.sender as a wallet module.
transferProxyOwnership is gated by onlyProxyOwner comparing msg.sender to the stored proxy owner.
Any caller can enter fallback; module authorization relies on methodToModule[msg.sig] and modules lookup.
claimOwnership is gated by onlyPendingOwner comparing msg.sender to pendingOwner.
addGuardian requires validSince >= block.timestamp, making guardian activation timestamp dependent.
removeGuardian requires validUntil >= block.timestamp, making guardian removal timestamp dependent.
checkAndAddToSpent relies on _spentQuota which decays spent amount using block.timestamp.
addToWhitelist clamps effective time to block.timestamp, controlling when a whitelist entry becomes usable.
touchLastActive writes uint64(block.timestamp) into wallets[wallet].lastActive.
setInheritor stores uint64(block.timestamp) as lastActive, driving inheritance timing.
Guardian status/timestamp transitions depend on comparisons with block.timestamp.
Timestamp-driven status writes mutate the wallets guardian state.
transact delegates the actual external interaction to _call.
mode 1 performs target.call{value: value}(data) allowing the callee to re-enter the wallet.
mode 2 performs target.delegatecall(data), executing untrusted code with wallet storage and privileges.
mode 3 performs target.staticcall(data) into a module-controlled address.
fallback forwards msg.value and msg.data to a bound module with no reentrancy guard, allowing re-entry.
Proxy.fallback delegatecalls the implementation address, a privileged upgrade point.
fallback resolves the target module from methodToModule[msg.sig] before dispatching the call.
sendETH performs an external value call that can re-enter the caller before state finalization.
fastCall performs an inline assembly call with arbitrary target and value.
fastCallAndVerify wraps fastCall and reverts on failure with raw returndata.
upgradeTo calls _upgradeTo to change the proxy implementation.
_upgradeTo validates the new implementation then calls setImplementation.
setImplementation performs an assembly sstore into the implementation slot.
setUpgradeabilityOwner performs an assembly sstore into the proxy owner slot.
Assembly sstore writes the keccak-derived proxy storage slots controlling ownership and implementation.
transferProxyOwnership updates the proxy owner via setUpgradeabilityOwner.
upgradeToAndCall first upgrades the implementation through upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall performs address(this).call{value: msg.value}(data) after upgrading, an external self-call.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership zeroes the owner state variable.
claimOwnership promotes pendingOwner into owner.
initOwner writes the initial owner into _owner, guarded against re-initialization.
init assigns the controller, which anchors factory and module registry authorization.
setOwner overwrites _owner.
addModule forwards to _addModule with the registry from the controller.
_addModule marks the module authorized in the modules mapping.
_addModule calls Module(_module).activate(), re-entering the wallet through the module.
removeModule calls Module(_module).deactivate() in a try/catch before deleting the module.
removeModule deletes the module entry from the modules mapping.
bindMethod writes the method-to-module dispatch entry.
verifyAndUpdate marks hashes[wallet][hash] as consumed after the module check.
checkAndAddToSpent reads the wallet quota record and updates spent amount.
addToSpent increases spentAmount in the quotas mapping.
changeQuota performs downcasting of quota values into uint128 fields of the quota struct.
addToWhitelist writes the effective time gating future whitelist-based spending.
removeFromWhitelist deletes the effective time, revoking whitelist authorization.
reimburseGasFee computes gasCost = gasAmount.mul(gasPrice) before transferring the fee.
reimburseGasFee charges the wallet quota via quotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent.
addGuardian mutates the wallets guardian array, index map and status.
removeGuardian mutates guardian status and timestamp for the wallet.
_cleanRemovedGuardians pops and reindexes entries in the wallets guardian array.
nonReentrant reads and writes _guardValue to prevent reentrant calls.
verifySignatures loops over signers calling verifySignature/verifyEOASignature.
verifyEOASignature recovers the signer via recoverECDSASigner.
verifyERC1271Signature staticcalls the untrusted signer contract with isValidSignature calldata.
verifyApproval recovers the ECDSA signer and requires it to be a manager.
register is onlyManager and validates the approval signature through verifyApproval.
UpgraderModule.activate removes obsoleted modules from the calling wallet.
activate migrates guardians into the new SecurityStore via addGuardian.
activate can change the wallet owner state indirectly through controller/wallet reconfiguration.
transact bubbles raw returndata and reverts through inline assembly on failure.
newOwner input flows into the owner storage write of transferOwnership.
Claimable transferOwnership stores newOwner in pendingOwner which claimOwnership promotes to owner.
_initialOwner flows into the _owner write of initOwner.
_controller is stored as the wallet controller, anchoring factory and store authorization.
_modules array elements are added as wallet modules during init.
_module is registered as an authorized module in the modules mapping.
mode selects between call, delegatecall and staticcall in the transact flow.
to is the target address passed down to _call.
value is forwarded as the ETH amount of the low-level call.
data is the calldata forwarded to the external target.
wallet selects the storage record and drives requireWalletModule authorization.
addr identifies the guardian entry to add or refresh.
validSince is compared to block.timestamp and stored as the guardian activation time.
alwaysOverride controls whether an existing pending addition timestamp is overwritten.
validUntil is compared to block.timestamp and stored as the guardian removal time.
newQuota is bounds-checked against MAX_QUOTA and downcast into uint128.
effectiveTime is downcast to uint64 and stored as pendingUntil.
pos indexes the guardian entry before status-dependent branching.
g carries guardian status/timestamp into the add/remove decision branches.
success from _call determines whether transact bubbles the revert.
module resolved from methodToModule[msg.sig] is used as the fallback call target.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is stored into pendingOwner and only becomes meaningful when claimOwnership promotes it to owner.
_initialOwner is a one-shot initialization input written directly into _owner.
_controller is consumed entirely by init to set the controller state variable.
The module array is only iterated inside init to call _addModule.
_module is validated and registered by addModule/_addModule.
mode is only used to select the low-level call primitive executed by _call.
to becomes the target address of the low-level call, so it is subsumed by that unsafe operation.
value is attached as the ETH amount of the low-level call, part of the same unsafe operation.
data is the calldata payload of the low-level call, meaningless outside that operation.
wallet selects the storage record and the authorization check performed by addGuardian.
addr is only used for guardian index lookup and array insertion inside addGuardian.
validSince is compared to block.timestamp and cast into the guardian timestamp field, feeding the timestamp-dependent write.
alwaysOverride is a pure branch selector inside addGuardian.
validUntil is compared to block.timestamp and stored as the guardian removal timestamp.
newQuota is bounds-checked and downcast into the quota struct by changeQuota.
effectiveTime is only downcast and stored as pendingUntil by changeQuota.
pos is a short-lived index derived from guardianIdx inside addGuardian.
The memory Guardian copy g is only inspected for status branching within addGuardian/removeGuardian.
success is the boolean result of _call used only to decide whether transact reverts.
module is the dispatch target resolved from methodToModule[msg.sig] inside fallback.
